nodes.name: APPLY_FIX_NOW.sh
nodes.summary: Shell script that applies the correct fix for the Pydantic v2 migration, reverting prior bad Phase 2 changes and re-applying the intended edits to finance contract models.

nodes.name: scripts/README.md
nodes.summary: Documents the GWTF R25 branch-protection compliance scripts (preflight checklist and daily audit), including usage commands and recommended shell aliases.

nodes.name: cleanup_fix_modified_files.sh
nodes.summary: Remediation script that removes files which were mistakenly modified instead of deleted during a prior cleanup, eliminating broken imports left behind.

nodes.name: cleanup_non_core_tests.sh
nodes.summary: Removes non-core test files (integration/API/CLI, legacy, output artifacts) to keep the feature branch pristine while retaining the core module test suite.

nodes.name: cleanup_non_core_tests_COMPLETE.sh
nodes.summary: Complete variant of the test-cleanup routine that removes 79 enumerated non-core test files and keeps 63 core tests, with summary reporting.

nodes.name: deploy_cashflow_refactor.sh
nodes.summary: Automates deployment of the refactored cashflow v14 tax module: backs up the current file, swaps in the refactored version and tests, runs mypy and unit tests, and shows integration points.

nodes.name: dutchbay_repo_cleanup.sh
nodes.summary: Automatic repository cleanup tool that archives or deletes legacy/experimental files into legacy_* directories for the v14 focus, supporting dry-run, archive, and delete modes with a JSON inventory report.

nodes.name: move_file
nodes.summary: Moves a file into the appropriate legacy archive directory, tracking byte size and per-category counters for the cleanup inventory report.

nodes.name: delete_file
nodes.summary: Permanently deletes a file when running in delete mode, incrementing the deletion counter and accumulating reclaimed size for the report.

nodes.name: dutchbay_repo_cleanup_fixed.sh
nodes.summary: Corrected version of the repository cleanup tool, identical in structure to dutchbay_repo_cleanup.sh, archiving or deleting legacy files into legacy_* directories with dry-run support and JSON reporting.

nodes.name: move_file
nodes.summary: Moves a file into the matching legacy archive directory while tracking size and per-category counters for the cleanup inventory.

nodes.name: delete_file
nodes.summary: Permanently removes a file in delete mode, updating the deletion count and reclaimed-size totals for reporting.

nodes.name: dutchbay_thread_migration_package.txt
nodes.summary: Migration handoff package describing the project's 'Go With The Flow' ruleset, proven YAML/config-driven patterns, phased to-do list, and diagnostic checklists for the DutchBay analytics stack.

nodes.name: fix_ruff_e402.sh
nodes.summary: Adds 'ruff: noqa: E402' suppression to specific analytics modules (evaluation_v14, sensitivity_v14) so module-level imports after code pass linting.

nodes.name: fix_vulnerabilities.sh
nodes.summary: Automated remediation for Dependabot security alerts that activates the venv and upgrades the flagged vulnerable Python packages.

nodes.name: freeze_validation_sprint17.sh
nodes.summary: Un-gameable freeze-validation gate for Sprint 17 (Pydantic v2 + pipeline verification) that runs a colored, multi-check suite to confirm the model is release-ready.

nodes.name: gwtf-daily-audit.sh
nodes.summary: GWTF R25 daily compliance audit that checks for direct commits to main and other branch-protection violations at the end of a work session.

nodes.name: gwtf-preflight.sh
nodes.summary: GWTF R25 pre-flight checklist run before any git merge, pull, or push to verify the current branch and branch-protection state.

nodes.name: phase1_quickstart.sh
nodes.summary: Automates the critical Phase 1 validation steps for the sensitivity_v14.py golden-reference implementation, checking the file exists and validating its syntax and behavior.

nodes.name: rollback_phase2_and_fix_properly.sh
nodes.summary: Emergency rollback script that reverts harmful Phase 2 Pydantic-migration changes and re-applies the correct fixes.

nodes.name: run_all_fixes.sh
nodes.summary: Master orchestration script that executes the full set of Pydantic v2 migration fixes (Phase 2) after verifying the active git branch.

nodes.name: run_phase2_fixes.sh
nodes.summary: Applies targeted Phase 2 fixes for remaining test failures, such as replacing TornadoResult.model_validate() calls with direct construction based on actual pytest errors.

nodes.name: run_phase_1_2_tests.sh
nodes.summary: Test runner that activates the Python 3.11 venv and executes the Phase 1-2 refactoring test suite to verify the implementation.

nodes.name: run_sprint10_gates.sh
nodes.summary: Minimal Sprint 10 gate suite that runs import/compile gates on the core pipeline, cashflow, and debt modules to confirm they build cleanly.
